hosting_dashboard_spoofing_modal_title: Action required for your e-mail sending
hosting_dashboard_spoofing_modal_intro:
E-mails sent without SMTP authentication have been detected from your hosting.
To better protect your e-mail sending against fraudulent use, this sending method will soon be blocked.
Your hosting currently benefits from a temporary exception to give you time to change your configuration.
If you do nothing, the affected e-mails will no longer be sent from your hosting.
